paper_id: Chen et al. - 2007 - Indexable PLA for Efficient Similarity Search
title: Indexable PLA for Efficient Similarity Search
motivation: PLA是唯一没有索引机制的降维方法,但实验显示其效果不逊于APCA等方法,却只能线性扫描
problem_framing: 为PLA设计一个满足下界引理的可索引距离函数dist_PLA,使得R树过滤不错过任何真实结果
key_insight: 等长分段加'重新从1开始计起点'的技巧,使线段对之间的最小距离可解析计算,从而可索引
method_signature: dist_PLA下界距离函数 + R树索引 + 查询点到MBR的最小距离计算
evaluation_criteria: 剪枝能力(pruning power)和实际查询时间(wall clock time),对比APCA和CP
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: 仅支持等长分段,变长分段的PLA索引留作future work
evidence_for_taste: PLA is the only one... that does not have an indexable lower bound
our zooming in the second pair, the starting index always begins with '1'
the tighter the lower bound distance is, the higher the pruning power is
PLA is always the best, in terms of the pruning power
only feasible way to perform similarity search based on PLA is the linear scan
thinking_moves: 发现PLA效果好但无法索引的矛盾,先做实验证明PLA潜力
聚焦tightness of lower bound而非重建误差作为核心指标
借鉴GEMINI框架,用下界距离函数+R树解决非索引问题
将全局距离分解为各分段距离之和,逐段证明下界引理成立
通过数学归纳法从l=2递归证明wl≥0,严密的数学证明
